title: Risk Premium Credit on Cancellation: Computation Sheet for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
The risk premium cancellation credit of a policy under the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) is fixed when the cancellation is processed.

## 1. Cancellation effective date

The cancellation effective date follows the reason on the signed request, read from the latest signed cancellation request received on the policy, a withdrawn or unsigned request not counting: the event date the request names for a building sold, a building removed or demolished, or contents sold or removed; the current term start for a removal from the Special Flood Hazard Area by a Letter of Map Amendment or Revision; the policy's original effective date for a duplicate NFIP policy or a loan closing that did not occur; for a replacement by private flood insurance, the date the request names when it falls after the request was received; otherwise the date the signed request was received.

## 2. Scope

For the risk premium a cancellation credits when it is processed, and only for that credit, and only while the current term and the term before it together carry at most one premium-bearing endorsement and at most one re-rate credit, each counted by its risk premium entries, the reason's refund method is applied over the current term and the term before it as this sheet sets out, and risk premium of terms earlier than that is returned only through the NFIP Bureau. When those terms carry more than one premium-bearing endorsement or more than one re-rate credit, the refund method follows the reason as the base cancellation rule states it: full from inception returns every risk premium charge booked on the policy; current term full returns the current term's risk premium in full; pro rata returns the current term's risk premium multiplied by the days from the cancellation effective date to the term end divided by the days from the term start to the term end, with the claim bar of section 4. The ICC premium, Reserve Fund Assessment, HFIAA surcharge, Federal Policy Fee and probation surcharge follow the cancellation refund rule, and every other credit follows the refund method as the base cancellation rule states it.

## 3. The credit

The risk premium credit of a cancellation is worked out from the risk premium of the current term and of the term before it, a term's risk premium being the risk premium charges booked for that term apart from those of the policy's latest premium-bearing endorsement. The current term's risk premium is returned for the days from the cancellation effective date to the term end over the days of the current term, nothing is returned for the term before it, the latest premium-bearing endorsement's risk premium charges are returned with the term premium they belong to, and no re-rate credit is taken back. The working adds the returned parts in the order this sheet sets them out, and then subtracts the part taken back; each part is rounded half-up to the cent and the credit is never below zero.

Endorsement charges returned with the term premium they belong to are returned for the days from the cancellation effective date to the end of their term over the days of the current term when their term is the one the cancellation takes effect in, in full when their term began after the cancellation effective date, and not at all when their term ended before it; the term before the current one ends at the current term start, and the days of a term are counted as the days of the current term.

## 4. Claim bar

A policy with an open claim is not cancelled until every claim on it is closed, so the claim bar is applied once the claims are closed. Under the reasons mortgage paid off, voluntary — not required, replaced by private flood, and removed from the Special Flood Hazard Area by a Letter of Map Amendment or Revision, nothing is returned for the current term, the latest premium-bearing endorsement's risk premium charges included, when a loss dated on or after the current term start carries claim payments, net of the payment items voided, above zero. Where the records cannot place such a paid loss on either side of the current term start, that is when no loss dated after the month band around the current term start carries such payments, a loss dated in that band does, and the latest loss on which a claim payment was ever issued is dated after the band, or is dated in the band on or after the current term start with its payments all voided, the month band being the losses dated as many whole calendar months before the processing date as the current term start is, the current term's return is held: nothing of the current term, the latest premium-bearing endorsement's risk premium charges included, is returned by this credit. In every other case no refund at all is due for the current term under those reasons when a claim with a date of loss in the current term has been paid or is still open.

## 5. Worked figure (hypothetical)

A 365-day current term; risk premium charges for the term 3,650.00, no endorsement and no re-rate; reason building sold, effective with 100 days of the term left; no claims. Current term returned: 3,650.00 times 100 over 365, which is 1,000.00. Nothing for the term before. Credit: 1,000.00.

The same policy cancelled as voluntary — not required, with a loss dated in the current term carrying net claim payments of 12,000.00: nothing of the current term is returned and the credit is 0.00.
